subject.title: fix(agents): carry current-turn inbound metadata in a tail runtime-context message for byte-stable prompt caching

question: May current-turn inbound metadata move from active prompt text into a tail runtime-context carrier as the permanent compatibility path once current-head proof is added?
rationale: The PR changes model/provider/hook-visible current-turn context placement and an exported LLM message shape; automation can verify code paths, but maintainers should own that compatibility trade-off.

options.title: Require proof then accept the carrier
options.body: Require current-head live or diagnostic proof for metadata preservation and cache anchor placement, then proceed if the compatibility review is clean.

options.title: Accept tests-only compatibility risk
options.body: Maintainers can choose to accept the new carrier contract based on focused tests and the prior cache-effect artifact, but real channel/provider regressions would be owned after merge.

options.title: Pause for the narrower handoff PR
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the runtime-context handoff in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89428 to land first and then rebase the cache-anchor work on top.

recommendation.title: Require proof then accept the carrier
recommendation.body: Require current-head live or diagnostic proof for metadata preservation and cache anchor placement, then proceed if the compatibility review is clean.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman carried much of the prior LLM-boundary cache-stability follow-up work and is the strongest history signal for the compatibility decision.
